CDK Global, LLC develops cloud-based software for automotive dealerships and manufacturers. The Associate Software Engineer builds and ships production automotive retail software using AI-based development workflows, with responsibility for code quality, security, reliability, and collaboration across teams.
Automotive
Marketing
Retail
Software
Digital Marketing
Retail Technology
Sales
No H1B
Responsibilities
Build and ship production software using modern AI-based development workflows, progressing from AI-accelerated coding to delegating well-scoped tasks to advanced AI systems
Write precise specifications, technical plans, and acceptance criteria that humans and AI systems can execute against
Own the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship — rigorously review, test, and validate all AI-generated code, and never expose credentials, customer data, or proprietary code to unapproved tools
Keep codebases lean: resist AI-generated bloat, unnecessary dependencies, and over-engineering so today's velocity doesn't become tomorrow's technical debt
Use AI development resources cost-effectively, treating compute and tooling spend as an engineering constraint to optimize
Develop deep expertise in automotive retail — how dealerships operate and how consumers buy — the domain context that makes your direction of AI systems effective
Solve problems of moderate scope with increasing independence and sound technical judgment
Experiment with and share new AI development techniques and workflow improvements with your team
Plan and prioritize your own work with decreasing need for day-to-day direction; build strong relationships across engineering, product, and design
Participate in on-call rotations and emergency response to maintain platform reliability
Follow all CDK Global policies and procedures, including responsible AI usage guidelines; complete all mandatory compliance tasks
Meet or exceed all performance expectations
Qualification
Node.js
React.js
AWS
Computer Science Fundamentals
Code Analysis
Software Security
Spec-Driven Development
Apache Kafka
MongoDB
Version Control
Code Review
Automated Testing
CI/CD
Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 0–2 years of professional experience
Experience with NodeJS, ReactJS, and AWS Cloud
Strong command of at least one programming language and core CS fundamentals — the foundation for evaluating and improving AI-generated code, not just writing code by hand
Ability to read and reason about code you didn't write: spotting bugs, edge cases, security issues, and design problems
Excellent written communication — describing problems and designs precisely is a core skill in this role
Genuine curiosity about AI-based development, shown through coursework, projects, hackathons, or independent experimentation
A verification mindset: skepticism of unvalidated output, rigor in testing before trusting, and the instinct that more code is not better code and security cannot be bolted on afterward
Self-motivated fast learner — the tools will change; your adaptability won't
Collaborative problem-solver, effective independently and in teams; able to drive issues to timely resolution
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based visa sponsorship
Preferred
Substantive personal or academic projects using AI development tools — and the ability to articulate what worked, what failed, and what you learned
Experience with Spec-Driven Development (SDD), Kafka, and Mongo
Exposure to version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD
Experience anywhere in a modern full stack (mobile/web front ends, backend APIs, databases, cloud)
Interest in building software that business operators and consumers depend on
Benefits
Hybrid Austin, TX: a mix of days in CDK's Austin, TX office and remote work on the remaining days; candidates must reside within commuting distance of this office.
Structured mentorship
A defined progression path
Real production ownership early
Annual performance bonus
Benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans
